resources.string: Phone activity

While you are working in ProBeing (not on a break, not after End day), this phone tells ProBeing which app was on screen and from when to when: every 15 minutes, and every few minutes while a distraction is on. Only the app\'s name and the times. Never what is on the screen, never notification text. Banking, wallets, chats and messages go only as \"private\", with no name.\n\nYouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok and Facebook are distractions here: 10 minutes on one and you get a push; ignore it 5 minutes and it becomes a break from when it started, unless your laptop shows work in the same minutes (then ProBeing asks you later).
